Problem Statement:
Given two strings, determine if they are anagrams. 
Input Description:
Two strings (1 ≤ length ≤ 100). 
Output Description:
Print YES if they are anagrams, otherwise NO. 
Sample Input:

silent 
Sample Output:
YES
